intro:

The core premise of Save the Cats is to throw the yarn ball towards the handle of the cage, and if successful, the cage door will open, freeing the trapped cat. The game has a unique art style that is both cute and adorable, with vibrant colors and endearing cat characters. The music is also soothing and calming, making it perfect for players of all ages.
